outputs.name: G
outputs.purpose: The diagram (GraphNetDiagram), ColorMode "user" with K(i,i) in BusColorData and the couplings as BranchLineWidth.

outputs.name: tab_coupling
outputs.purpose: Couplings of the section shown first: Bus1, Bus2, Coupling, Branch.

inputs.name: Quantity
inputs.purpose: Quantity: "damping" (share in an eigenvalue), "synchronizing" (dP/dtheta of the ports) or "voltage" (dQ/drho of the ports). Default: "damping".

inputs.name: State
inputs.purpose: Ports of "synchronizing" and "voltage": states "settled" (eliminated) or "fixed" (held at the point). Default: "settled".

inputs.name: Mode
inputs.purpose: Mode picked first ("damping"): a column of get_participation(Type="DAE"). Default: 1.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.purpose: Section shown first (1 ... numel(rv_t)); res.Index when omitted. Default: obj.Index.

inputs.name: Parent
inputs.purpose: Container (figure, uifigure, uipanel, uitab, uigridlayout) to draw in; [] for a new figure. Default: [].

outputs.name: sct_graph
outputs.purpose: Eigenvalue (GraphChart), Diagram (GraphNetDiagram) and Table (uitable).

inputs.name: Type
inputs.purpose: Model whose modes are returned: "ODE" or "DAE"; the Type of the result when omitted. Default: obj.Type.

inputs.name: MinFrequency
inputs.purpose: [Hz] Smallest frequency kept; > 0 keeps the oscillatory modes only. Default: 0.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.purpose: Section (1 ... numel(rv_t)) or "all" (a struct array, tab_mode with the columns Time and Index); res.Index when omitted. Default: obj.Index.

inputs.name: Time
inputs.purpose: [s] Time: the section whose rv_t is nearest; overrides Index.

outputs.name: sct_mode
outputs.purpose: tab_mode (Eigenvalue, Frequency [Hz], DampingRatio, DominantOwner), rm_participation, cm_shape (states x modes), sv_state, sv_owner (states), s_type (1 x n_t for Index "all").

inputs.name: Type
inputs.purpose: Model whose modes are used: "ODE" or "DAE"; the Type of the result when omitted. Default: obj.Type.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.purpose: Section (1 ... numel(rv_t)) or "all" (a struct array, one per section); res.Index when omitted. Default: obj.Index.

inputs.name: Time
inputs.purpose: [s] Time: the section whose rv_t is nearest; overrides Index.

outputs.name: sct_part
outputs.purpose: rm_value (states x modes), cv_lambda [1/s], sv_state, sv_owner, tab_bus (Bus, Participation), tab_global (Owner, Participation), s_type (1 x n_t for Index "all").

inputs.name: Type
inputs.purpose: Model: "ODE" (the bus voltages eliminated) or "DAE" (the connected model); the Type of the result when omitted. Default: obj.Type.

inputs.name: Port
inputs.purpose: Bus port of "DAE" (v, w): "PI" ([theta,V], [P,Q/V]), "PQ" ([theta,rho], [P,Q]) or "I" ([Vre,Vim], [-Iim,Ire]); options.Port of the result when omitted. Default: default_port(obj).

inputs.name: Input
inputs.purpose: Inputs of the model: "u" or Labels. Default: all inputs.

inputs.name: Output
inputs.purpose: Outputs of the model: "x", "V", "I", "y" or names. Default: as described for each algorithm.

inputs.name: Format
inputs.purpose: Form of the model: "ss" (dss; needs the Control System Toolbox) or "struct" (A, B, C, D, E and names). Default: "ss".

inputs.name: Index
inputs.purpose: Section of the model (1 ... numel(rv_t)); res.Index when omitted. Default: obj.Index.

inputs.name: Time
inputs.purpose: [s] Time: the section whose rv_t is nearest; overrides Index.

inputs.name: Form
inputs.purpose: View: "descriptor", "absorbed" (E^-1 in the dynamic rows) or "hessian" (energy-function form); res.Form when omitted. Default: obj.Form.

outputs.name: sys
outputs.purpose: Linear model in the form of Format, with StateName, InputName and OutputName.

inputs.name: target
inputs.purpose: Tags and class (or package) names of the elements; several are summed.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.purpose: Section of the DAE (1 ... numel(rv_t)); res.Index when omitted. Default: obj.Index.

outputs.name: sct_value
outputs.purpose: Part of the targets: A, B, C, D, E (the size of the DAE), StateName, InputName, OutputName.

outputs.name: sct_mask
outputs.purpose: Entries the targets change: A, B, C, D, E (logical), StateName, InputName, OutputName.

inputs.purpose: Model: "ODE" or "DAE"; the Type of the result when omitted. Default: obj.Type.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.purpose: Section (1 ... numel(rv_t)) or "all" (a table with the columns Time and Index); res.Index when omitted. Default: obj.Index.

inputs.name: Time
inputs.purpose: [s] Time: the section whose rv_t is nearest; overrides Index.

outputs.name: sct_kernel
outputs.purpose: rm_right, rm_left (variables x n_dim), sv_state (variables), tab_phase, n_dim, s_port, s_message (1 x n_t for Index "all").
